item.title: docs(qqbot): point install docs at the Tencent package (#122417)
item.summary: docs(qqbot): point install docs at the Tencent package (#122417) The externalization left the docs inventory seed and the channel page advertising the retired @openclaw/qqbot npm package; the catalog already resolves qqbot to @tencent-connect/openclaw-qqbot. Regenerates the plugin reference and inventory pages from the corrected seed.
